recentItems.title: Minecraft - Official The Ice Caves Trailer
recentItems.description:
Get a first look at the Holiday Drop! It adds Ice Caves, a new cave biome with icicles, light-emitting ice crystals, calcite, and a frozen zombie variant that deals a freezing effect – some throw ice balls. Brr! The Ice Caves Holiday Drop is coming later this year.

recentItems.title: Minecraft Dungeons 2 - Official Get Ready Trailer
recentItems.description:
Get ready for Minecraft: Dungeons 2! Check out this brand-new trailer and get ready to return to the world of Minecraft Dungeons in an all-new adventure, brimming with high-stakes encounters, thrilling challenges, and never-before-seen locations. You defeated Arch-Illager in the first game, so this should be a walk in the park, right? A brand-new dimension: The Sift, missions that focus on your own exploration, and the angriest Illagers you’ve ever seen are just some things you can expect from Minecraft Dungeons 2! Minecraft Dungeons 2 is launching on September 29 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Xbox Cloud and Steam).

recentItems.title: Halo Needs a Reinvention
recentItems.description:
After a massive shake-up within Xbox, the keys to the Halo franchise have been given to Activision, putting a cloud of uncertainty over the future of the series. In this video, we discuss what this could mean for the iconic sci-fi shooter and how Activision can go about it
For 15 years, Halo Studios struggled to capture the magic of Bungie's success after success with Halo games. We dive into why attempting to replicate the past ended up hurting the franchise, creating a fractured identity across Halo 4, 5, and Infinite. 
Will Activision turn Halo into a Call of Duty clone packed with aggressive microtransactions and battle passes? Or can they give the franchise the "DOOM" treatment, successfully reinventing the core combat loop for a new generation?

recentItems.title: Werwulf - Official Trailer 2
recentItems.description:
Take another look at Werwulf in this brand-new trailer! Robert Eggers returns to helm this adaptation of the Wolfman myth, promising to be the most visceral and haunting experience Eggers has done so far! 
In the Medieval English countryside, a mysterious and terrible creature stalks the night, preying on any who come across its path. 
Werwulf see's Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Willem Dafoe, and Lily-Rose Depp returning from their work together on Eggers last movie; Nosferatu, for an all new terrifying take on the classic mythos. 
Werwulf comes to cinemas on December 25th 2026!
